julesThoughtProcess: Selected a vibrant neon pink (#FF3366) to convey a sense of warmth and resilient energy, matching the atmospheric and hopeful slice-of-life tone.
storyPanel: The mag-lev train rattled overhead, showering the damp alleyway in brief flashes of neon. Life in the lower tiers isn't easy—prosthetic maintenance is expensive, and the smog filters need constant replacing. Yet, beneath the hum of cooling towers, a synthetic merchant and a tired mechanic share a laugh over a bowl of synthetic noodles. The city is gritty and loud, but in these quiet, shared moments, you can feel the warmth of a community that simply refuses to break.
